content.text: Is it reasonable to build similarity matrixies?

Yes, and it's nearly free. The kit already computes, for every spell and every rival skill, what it nets in each of the same 1,208 punish situations. Correlating those per-situation scores, weighted by how often each situation comes up, gives the matrix: two attacks that land in the same situations come out as near-duplicates. That's a few seconds on top of a kit run. Adding melee-only ashes means scoring every skill once, roughly 20 to 30 minutes. It would only measure how similar two attacks are as punishes, not in neutral or as buffs.
